events.title: What's new in 0.1.11 - attacks you can read on any floor, and improved Crucible
events.summary: Update 0.1.11 is live for the game and the demo. **Reading a fight**- Boss attacks keep their colours under every light. In the fire floors they used to sink into the same dark red as the ground.- Every attack zone has a rim, so its edge is never in doubt. Where two attacks overlap, the tile shows a hatch and a count. Arena-wide pulls show a frame and a name instead of painting every tile.- Fighters in a dark arena carry a faint light of their own, so they never vanish into the floor. **Combat**

events.title: The Campaign Forge demo is live — forge your first world today
events.summary: The demo is out, and it is the real thing. Three acts, all free: Play immediately — The Ember Road. A small hand-crafted opening chapter, playablethe moment the demo loads. Pick your class, land at Brackwater with wet bootsand no plans, and find out why the beacon went dark. No setup, no waiting. Forge your own world.
